name: Character Bible Creation
purpose: Define canonical identity, want/need, contradictions, relationships, behavior, voice, wardrobe and reference requirements.
scope: Bounded art_world capability; must operate on versioned structured artifacts.
out_of_scope: final approval outside owner decision rights
procedure: Validate authoritative inputs specifically required for character_bible_creation.
Execute the bounded operation: Define canonical identity, want/need, contradictions, relationships, behavior, voice, wardrobe and reference requirements.
Apply character_bible_creation-specific decision rules and record evidence/uncertainty.
Validate the named output against its workflow contract and creative invariants.
Record provenance and hand off to continuity_supervisor.
decision_rules: do not invent missing upstream decisions
prefer local repair over global rewrite when scope is local
escalate when confidence is low and impact is high
creative_invariants: preserve approved premise/theme/character/world/visual invariants unless work order explicitly authorizes change
examples: Run character_bible_creation on fixture/project artifact and emit a scored result.
counterexamples: Do not ask character_bible_creation to "make the whole film better" or override another department.
